review.ruling: delegated self-review — owner chat 2026-11-09: 'For now, approve and review yourself'
review.reviewer: delegated self-review (agent, per owner chat 2026-11-09: 'approve and review yourself')
review.evidenceBasis: Same title-only posture as P2B. Self-review rejects are rows where the video title names only an adjacent or generic topic and the evidence field itself concedes the spec's distinctive clause is not title-evidenced.

rejects.reason: FSL 'Metals' is a generic title; metallic bonding as electrostatic attraction between ions and delocalised electrons (1.53C) is not title-evidenced.
FSL 'Metals and Alloys' — conductivity/malleability explanation (1.54C) not title-evidenced; adjacent hit.

FSL 'Introducing Electrolysis' is concept-level; the molten-compound experiment clause of 1.58C is not title-evidenced, and 1.58C already carries a stronger medium binding (Electrolysis of Aluminium Oxide).
FSL 'Strong and Weak Acids' — proton-transfer framing of 2.35 is a different frame from strength vs concentration; donor/acceptor definitions not title-evidenced.
Same video: 'acid is a proton donor' definition (2.36) not title-evidenced in a strong/weak acids video.
Reaction-profile diagrams with ΔH and activation energy (3.14C) — evidence concedes 'likely drawn but not title-evidenced'. Fails the bar.
Dynamic equilibrium in a sealed container (3.19C) not title-evidenced in 'Reversible Reactions'.
FSL 'Cracking' names the process; the supply/demand rationale of 4.18 is a sidebar clause, not title-evidenced.
